title: Transplanting Tomatoes Rooting Technique Explained
reason: Shows the process of transplanting tomato plants and the benefits of burying the entire plant.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the technique of burying tomato plants during transplantation.

subtasks.text: Choose healthy tomato plants that are growing well.
Carefully separate and tease the roots of the tomato plants.
Ensure the planting hole is deep enough to accommodate the entire plant.
Plant the tomato so the stem is completely covered with soil.
Explain the benefits of burying the stem for root development.

tasks.task: Discuss the importance of proper sun exposure and initial care after planting.

subtasks.text: Highlight the need for six to eight hours of sun daily.
Mention the practice of watering before transplanting.
Instruct on providing proper care to prevent wilting.
Emphasize the effectiveness of this planting method.
